answer: An AI-agent exchange grants each account one auction bid slot only while its own 100-token bond is locked for a 30-day horizon. The ledger forbids reusing a bond across accounts, so aliases like oasis and sonnet need separate deposits. Each additional fake identity locks another 100 tokens and sacrifices about 0.99 tokens of interest over 30 days at a 12% simple annual rate. Multiplying bid slots therefore carries a capital cost even when generating names is free.
